fullTextEN: Hello everyone, I am Jiaqi.

fullTextZH: 今天我想和大家分享一个经历。
fullTextEN: Today I want to share an experience with everyone.

fullTextZH: 就是我是怎么把我的两只猫
fullTextEN: It's about how I brought my two cats
back to China from Spain.

fullTextZH: 我回国的这个决定是很突然的。
fullTextEN: My decision to return to China was very sudden.

fullTextZH: 突然就是，我以前的时候
fullTextEN: Suddenly, I realized before

fullTextZH: 没有想到我会做这个决定。
fullTextEN: I never thought I would make this decision.

fullTextZH: 所以我突然做了这个回国的决定。
fullTextEN: So I suddenly made the decision to return to China.
At first, I thought,

fullTextZH: 我12月的时候可以回国看我的家人，
fullTextEN: I could return to China in December to see my family,
see my friends.
Then I would return to Spain.

fullTextZH: 可是因为我有了一些工作上的问题，
fullTextEN: But because I had some work-related issues,

fullTextZH: 所以我突然决定回国了。
fullTextEN: so I suddenly decided to return to China.

fullTextZH: 当我做这个决定的时候，
fullTextEN: When I made this decision,
I thought about:

fullTextZH: 我要不要把我的两只猫咪
fullTextEN: Should I bring my two cats
back to China with me?
I thought for a moment,

fullTextZH: 我觉得我是它们的妈妈，
fullTextEN: I feel like I am their mom,

fullTextZH: 我觉得我需要带它们和我一起回国。
fullTextEN: I feel I need to take them back home with me.
Then I started looking online,

fullTextZH: 我应该怎么把我的两只猫咪带回中国，
fullTextEN: How should I bring my two cats back to China,

fullTextZH: 我都需要准备什么东西。
fullTextEN: What things do I need to prepare.
After reading,

fullTextZH: 我发现我要准备的东西真的很多很多，
fullTextEN: I found that I have a lot of things to prepare,

fullTextZH: 而且很多的文件都是有时间要求的。
fullTextEN: And many documents have time requirements.
So,

fullTextZH: 如果我多一天或者少一天都不可以。
fullTextEN: If I am one day early or late, it won't work.

fullTextZH: 所以从我决定回国的那一天起，
fullTextEN: So from the day I decided to return home,

fullTextZH: 我每天都在准备这些东西，
fullTextEN: I prepare these things every day,
It takes a lot of time and is very tiring.

fullTextZH: 我在准备这些东西的时候，
fullTextEN: While preparing these things,
I would think:
Taking them back home,

fullTextZH: 真的是一个正确的、对的决定吗？
fullTextEN: Is it really the right decision?

fullTextZH: 但是我每次看到我的两只猫的时候，
fullTextEN: But every time I see my two cats,

fullTextZH: 我觉得我还是想要它们和我一起走。
fullTextEN: I feel I still want them to go with me.

fullTextZH: 虽然准备的这一个过程会很麻烦，
fullTextEN: Although this preparation process is troublesome,

fullTextZH: 但是有一件很幸运的事情就是：
fullTextEN: But one very fortunate thing is:

fullTextZH: 我买的是宠物友好的航班。
fullTextEN: The flight I booked is pet-friendly.

fullTextZH: 宠物友好就是他们对宠物（比如猫、狗）都很友好，
fullTextEN: Pet-friendly means they are very friendly to pets (like cats and dogs),
All very good. So,

fullTextZH: 我在不知道自己要带着猫回国的时候，
fullTextEN: When I didn't know I would be bringing my cat back home,
I booked a pet-friendly flight.
That is to say,

fullTextZH: 我可以把我的两只猫咪
fullTextEN: I can bring my two cats
on the plane with me.
So when I knew

fullTextZH: 我可以带它们一起上飞机的时候，
fullTextEN: I could bring them on the plane with me,
I was relieved,
I was really happy.

fullTextZH: 但是我很快又发现了新的问题。
fullTextEN: But I quickly discovered a new problem.
The first problem is:

fullTextZH: 我的两只猫只能放在一个猫包里面。
fullTextEN: My two cats can only be placed in one cat carrier.

fullTextZH: 然后我的两只猫加上我的猫包
fullTextEN: Then my two cats plus my cat carrier
cannot be too heavy.

fullTextZH: 我坐飞机的时候它们会有六个月大，
fullTextEN: When I fly, they will be six months old,

fullTextZH: 所以我不知道它们会不会很胖，
fullTextEN: so I don't know if they will be too fat,
and not allowed on the plane.

fullTextZH: 所以我在给它们吃东西的时候很紧张，
fullTextEN: So I get very nervous when feeding them,

fullTextZH: 因为我不想它们吃得太多、
fullTextEN: because I don't want them to eat too much,
and become very fat,

fullTextZH: 但是我也希望它们能够很好地长大。
fullTextEN: but I also hope they can grow up well.
The second problem is bigger.

fullTextZH: 就是如果我想带我的宠物、
fullTextEN: It's if I want to take my pet,
take my cat back to China,
I can only take one cat back.

fullTextZH: 就是一个人只可以带一只猫进中国，
fullTextEN: It's that one person can only bring one cat into China,
but I have two cats,

fullTextZH: 所以我不知道应该怎么带两只猫回去。
fullTextEN: so I don't know how to take two cats back.
I can get on the plane,

fullTextZH: 但是我到了中国的时候，
fullTextEN: but when I arrive in China,
they will see and say:
"You brought two cats,
you cannot enter China."
I thought of many ways,

fullTextZH: 但是没有一个是可以让我在上飞机之前
fullTextEN: but none can let me know before boarding the plane
that:

fullTextZH: “好，我可以把我的猫咪带回中国的。”
fullTextEN: "Okay, I can take my cats back to China."
In other words,
Until the day of departure,
I didn't know

fullTextZH: 我的猫咪能不能跟我一起到中国。
fullTextEN: if my cat could go to China with me.
But fortunately,
Fortunately,

fullTextZH: 我在等飞机的时候看到了一个男生，
fullTextEN: While waiting for the plane, I saw a guy,
Then I asked him, I said:

fullTextZH: “你可以帮我带一只猫咪回国吗？”
fullTextEN: "Can you help me take a cat back to the country?"

fullTextZH: 我们是在同一个飞机上。
fullTextEN: We were on the same plane.
He thought for a moment,
Then he looked at his phone,
and felt there wasn't a big problem,
so he told me: "It's okay."
So the two of us

fullTextZH: 把两只猫咪在最后带回了中国。
fullTextEN: brought two cats back to China in the end.

fullTextZH: 我真的很谢谢这个男生。
fullTextEN: I really thank this guy.
The third question is:

fullTextZH: 我的猫咪在飞机上不见了。
fullTextEN: My cat disappeared on the plane.
Oh my, on the plane!
The cat is inside my cat carrier.

fullTextZH: 因为它们要在飞机上很长的时间，
fullTextEN: Because they have to be on the plane for a long time,
They can't come out.

fullTextZH: 所以等到大家都在睡觉、
fullTextEN: So when everyone is asleep,
and the lights are off,
I took out a cat,
I said, "You can take a look,

fullTextZH: 然后你可以呼吸更好一点。”
fullTextEN: and then you can breathe better."

fullTextZH: 所以我把这只猫抱出来了。
fullTextEN: So I took this cat out.

fullTextZH: 可是一开始猫是在小桌板上，
fullTextEN: But at first the cat was on the small table,
The cat was on the small table,
It sat there without moving.
I think
it shouldn't walk away,
It shouldn't walk away.

fullTextZH: 所以我转了头，再回来看它的时候，
fullTextEN: So when I turned my head and looked back,
it was gone.
Then I saw it on the floor,
and it was walking.

fullTextZH: 我说：“完了完了完了完了！”
fullTextEN: I said, "Oh no, oh no, oh no, oh no!"

fullTextZH: 我要怎么样才可以抓到它？
fullTextEN: What do I need to do to catch it?
How can I catch it?

fullTextZH: 所以我开始在飞机上找猫。
fullTextEN: So I started looking for the cat on the plane.
Because the cat is very small,
Then I needed to lie on the ground,
Lie on the ground to search,

fullTextZH: 一边很小声很小声地叫它的名字。
fullTextEN: While softly calling its name.
Because everyone was sleeping,

fullTextZH: 我差不多抓了十分钟，抓到了它。
fullTextEN: I caught it after about ten minutes.

fullTextZH: 所以幸运的也是我抓到了它。
fullTextEN: So luckily, I caught it.
Then on the plane

fullTextZH: 也没有因为我的猫咪发生很大的事情。
fullTextEN: Nothing major happened because of my cat.
So I—
Felt relieved.
From Spain to China
It took more than 20 hours in total.
So the journey was really hard.
But fortunately,
I successfully—

fullTextZH: 成功地把它们带回了中国。
fullTextEN: Successfully brought them back to China.
But this time,

fullTextZH: 我带我的猫从西班牙到中国
fullTextEN: I took my cat from Spain to China

fullTextZH: 只是这个旅程的第一段。
fullTextEN: It's just the first part of the journey.
There is another part of the journey,

fullTextZH: 是我把猫咪从北京带到上海。
fullTextEN: where I took the cat from Beijing to Shanghai.

fullTextZH: 那也是一段很紧张的旅途，
fullTextEN: That was also a very tense trip,

fullTextZH: 也发生了很多很多的事情。
fullTextEN: and many, many things happened.

fullTextZH: 但是我们下一次再来听吧，拜拜！
fullTextEN: But let's listen next time, bye!
